items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: If you didn't hear a piano, you would hear a record, Bessie Smith Lewis, all the wrong with King Oliver.

ctx.x: Pigpen? Did you play at the Pigpen? I played there once, with Professor Victor's band. But

that's where the old, I mean, that's where the professional musicians played. Now what I mean by professional musicians, the guys who were playing for the big money, a dollar and a half a night. Right. Were these dances they played for? Yeah, dances, yeah. Dances. Sometimes I think about the money that they paid us, and the money that the musicians were, and they were glad to make that money. Some of them used to play for nothing. There are some places where the guys used to go and play for drinks. Sure. They…
